notes.title: The Basic Campaigns Pack is finally LIVE!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38100921/fee717b6a9bad2d3b4f1388f5e6fa9566eec7d32.jpg[/img]

Hello everybody,
we have finally released the basic campaign pack, which completes the initial version of the game with the infinite triple adventure.

This DLC finally completes the planned game's series of [b]THREE[/b] basic campaigns, enriching it with new scenarios, objects, obstacles and above all new goals that are more difficult to score.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38100921/294f7aa880842fa7cbadb377f10618331f7548de.jpg[/img]

These contents complete the [b]BASE[/b] version of the game, waiting for the great future DLCs!
This pack contains two fantastic basic add-on campaigns, with [b]new scenarios and dynamics[/b]:

[b]- Grassland 1
- Tropical 1[/b]

[h2]Grassland 1[/h2]
This campaign is set on the [b]grassland[/b], with [b]bright moving objects [/b]and goals with a [b]big central obstacle[/b], to make it more difficult for the ball to enter!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38100921/afc44ce7de7007bdccd957e2b42d5774f73e4c5a.jpg[/img]

[h2]Tropical 1[/h2]
This campaign is set on a [b]tropical island[/b], with [b]rusted and metallic objects[/b]. Goals have [b]TRIPLE [/b]big obstacles to make the challenge to score even better!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38100921/7a1355aaba9aea22f825434c9a737399d8beb3ca.jpg[/img]

[h2]Activation[/h2]
Once this DLC is purchased, these locked game campaigns can be played with the 'Start!' Button.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38100921/888e3bb3f4277206d16ea709af997a60dc7dec34.jpg[/img]

notes.content:

Hello everyone,

[h1]- Improved user interface[/h1]

notes.title: OMG - One More Goal - The full version 1.0 available now!!
notes.content:
Hello everyone,
it was a long journey, but in the end we managed to reach the goal: [b]OMG - One More Goal has reached its final version 1.0!
[/b]
In this latest mega-update the game has been completely rebuilt in all its parts, and has been made much more fluid, commercial and fun.

[previewyoutube=ZjRELdeNUr4;full][/previewyoutube]
Below we list all the news of version 1.0, hoping you like them!

[h1]New visual style[/h1]
All the graphics in the game have been redesigned. Now the style is much more cheerful and cartoon style; lighting is more powerful and voxel technology has been abandoned to use simpler and more manageable structures.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38100921/69ab76831bb8427d166f9560fa683a57d414c2bf.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38100921/c1a2a9fcc1de92481bb14b52c645a724e9be1aa0.jpg[/img]

[h1]New procedural generation of levels[/h1]
The random generation of levels has been completely overhauled. Voxel technology is no longer used but a much more flexible and simple structure is now used.
The vegetation and trees are created in a more orderly and clear way.
Dynamic obstacles have also been revised and are now procedurally generated based on levels. Trees and obstacles increase as you progress through the game campaign, creating an increasingly beautiful and unpredictable challenge.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38100921/0f99e0546b62af0c12548a2e1c49d162de173bb5.jpg[/img]

[h1]New GUI[/h1]
The whole graphic interface of the game has been completely rewritten, to be more readable, cheerful and commercial.
The in-game GUI has also been completely revised to use much more readable and clear cartoon effects.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38100921/9949080ab5e060f74070ea17a281a77cfb28601e.jpg[/img]
[h1]New game statistics[/h1]
The game statistics have been revised and modified, removing the less important ones and inserting those fundamental for the game dynamics.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38100921/141e1c74da8328a8ff8d0381d4043433bd27a129.jpg[/img]
[h1]New scoring system[/h1]
The scoring system has also been completely revised.
We've added new rewards, new level stats, and additional scores now also take into account campaign difficulty, time played and actual match time.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38100921/15176b8edcdb0a2eefc2366f41b43f107c6ec822.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38100921/2684a66675214e0dbd0938fa52cb03bfc4e44923.jpg[/img]
[h1]New multiple online leaderboards[/h1]
Based on the new game statistics, the online rankings on Steam have also been changed, to have an increasingly fun and competitive challenge with other players from around the world!

[h1]Three endless game campaigns[/h1]
With this full version of the game which has a new procedural generation of levels, vegetation and obstacles, only three main game campaigns have been maintained for now:
Forest, Grassland and Tropical.
In fact, the new game mechanics allow for guaranteed fun with these campaigns.
[b]The standard edition of the game has the single Forest 1 campaign, the others are available as DLC.[/b]
Each campaign has different types of goals and obstacles.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38100921/0b199fb36a613af63882b3f8f02df7f15c486cb2.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38100921/aa326b028df8d207ebea4520ad6dd2bdd6a80ee2.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38100921/5b2ff692a4226a0d4737a422558a9c60ea114ebb.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38100921/bd879f221f789f2598a65cbe73ed5e62a65a336b.jpg[/img]

We hope you enjoy the full game!

notes.title: OMG - One More Goal! - Update 0.8.0 out NOW!!
notes.content:
Hello everyone,
the world of little player robots evolves, and new scenarios are opening up on the horizon.
The playing fields are enriched with new items, new unexpected events, new weapons and new mechanical balls!
Now rival teams look for new ways to win!

[previewyoutube=57eAZAuGqQU;full][/previewyoutube]
[h1]New campaigns[/h1]
Six fantastic new game campaigns have been added, with the option to start the main campaign which will explore all possible game scenarios (Full tour)!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38100921/2af58f2bfd36deaafe328263dc76bad54c10f82b.png[/img]
[h1]New balls[/h1]
New game balls have been added, all with different shapes and various physical characteristics.
In this way the game dynamics will vary depending on the scenario and you will have to find new game tactics!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38100921/0a1cb6d6fadba0e079e8b182f80ed6c9363470b1.png[/img]
[h1]New bullets[/h1]
New weapons and bullets have been added for the various campaigns, all with different characteristics for always different fights.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38100921/76ebe4da742dfedbee2711c4f9cf4abfd3b6ffae.png[/img]
[h1]New obstacles[/h1]
New dynamic obstacles have been added in front of the enemy goal, to increase the defense of the energy sources.
These obstacles vary by campaign, have various shapes and physical characteristics, and will need to be moved to score!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38100921/b55ff03b15c738fb85fb3e3e2d9ed1ac8160a1a6.png[/img]
[h1]New score multiplier[/h1]
Depending on the difficulty of the campaign there will be a score multiplier.
In this way the rewards will be balanced according to the type of game path chosen.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38100921/90985bf7e0599f9b2e7fc3eead5df947f88c2e9b.png[/img]
[h1]Road map[/h1]
The next update will be dedicated to a different and revamped system of scores, rewards, match statistics and more!  

[b]Enjoy!  [/b]

notes.title: Update 0.7.0 now LIVE!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38100921/684c66f5ea22f07daf470fa8ffcfde7fb1483ac4.png[/img]
Hello everyone!
Our journey begins with the first update that adds variety to the game campaigns.
[b]We started testing the game's potential by adding new gameplay content and refining the basic structure.[/b]

[previewyoutube=cG28r9Xd-ts;full][/previewyoutube]
[h1]New campaigns![/h1]
Three new procedural campaigns have been added, easily selectable when starting a new game.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38100921/60758aedbb83cbea3393039a2a175281690b4a31.jpg[/img]
[h1]New ball![/h1]
These new campaigns contain a new game ball, heavier and with an irregular structure.
In this way the game dynamics become much more varied and with unpredictable difficulties.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38100921/96a7d5e1b0824c191349779f09d03caa418add96.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38100921/bf92e09dbe8566b94a02d7cd1a105f2dfbe8d0fe.png[/img]
[h1]New bullets![/h1]
With these new campaigns, players will have a new weapon at their disposal, with projectiles with a floating trajectory and variable size.
This changes the dynamics of combat in a more fun way!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38100921/a30e52d5fa2290f24ec38d448dcc5dabf0d8f49c.png[/img]
[h1]New goals and multiple goalkeepers![/h1]
Much wider new goas have been added to these new campaigns, and these are defended by double goalkeepers.
This way you will have to find new techniques to score and pass the levels!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38100921/5c3921c2ca2fea83ea98de585573b37032e386db.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38100921/4cd16f2b3319215a7711566c3357aed91c6cdc02.png[/img]
[h1]Game structure updates[/h1]
- the flexibility and variety of the campaigns has been improved
- personalized balls have been enabled for each campaign
- customized weapons have been enabled for each campaign

Enjoy!

notes.title: OMG - One More Goal! Coming soon on Steam Early Access!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38100921/5c42585c8fcbf9e41b7603eb4f25fbddb134a460.png[/img]

[b]Hello everyone,
we are very happy to tell you that our game will be released on Steam soon in early access![/b]

During development we realized that the product was already playable and fun, with a complete management of the game modes and three infinite procedural campaigns.

We thought about it a lot and in the end we decided to make the game available on Steam in early access, in order to get in touch with the public as soon as possible and begin our adventure with the players.
We think this can be a nice experience for us and them.

[b]We have also already activated the online leaderboards, so that players can already compete with each other.[/b]

[h1]State of art[/h1]

[b]The game is currently at alpha version 0.6.0.[/b]
For now there are only three game campaigns, complete management of game statistics and main options.
The main game logic has been implemented with a first simple AI for NPCs.
These three campaigns have procedurally generated levels and are infinite, for now these use the same 'ball' and the same ammo for the players.

Multiple online rankings are already active and the control system is the definitive one. By this way players can already have fun and compete with each other, experiencing the gameplay.
In the future there will be many other game campaigns with new objects and variants, a complete management of the online 'backend' and a more developed 'social' features.

[b]There is therefore now the game's 'core engine', playable and fun![/b]

[previewyoutube=bj9pE4WESZw;full][/previewyoutube]
